gpt-5.6-luna.source: repository pricing catalog used by the frozen legacy lane

gpt-4o-2024-08-06.source: OpenAI model pricing for the pinned gpt-4o snapshot

reportedCosts.incrementalSession: provider tokens incurred by one frozen evaluation session, separated by model
reportedCosts.cleanCacheRebuild: provider tokens required to rebuild every cache entry from an empty cache
reportedCosts.marginalOnline: provider tokens for one online query after ingestion and cache priming
reportedCosts.amortizedIngest: ingestion provider cost divided by the exact eligible user or session population

rule: Report all four cost categories separately; never collapse them into one dollar figure.
